title: I built an app that turns Claude prompts into playable mini games. What game would you like to create?
author: RepulsivePirate1180
selftext:
I built an app that turns prompts into playable mini games, using Claude and other LLMs.

The goal was to see how far you can push the “describe what you want” workflow for game creation, not just generating code or ideas, but actually ending up with something people can play.

https://reddit.com/link/1uo3nr1/video/0elbaipj8fbh1/player

Claude helped a lot with breaking game ideas down into logic, mechanics, iteration steps, and playable prototypes. From there, the app lets you describe the gameplay, generate or edit assets with AI, test the game, improve it through chat, and publish it so others can discover and play it on web or in the app.

I’m still improving the creation flow, but it’s already been really interesting to see what kind of mini games can come out of a simple prompt.

The app is free and all published games can be played for free. I’d love to hear what kind of game you would try to create with this.

comments.author: RepulsivePirate1180
comments.body: The App is available in App & Play Store, you can just try it out and send feedback or share your experience if you like.
